svg.title: How a release moves a file of the project
svg.desc: An update of the blueprint leaves the files of the project as they are, such as the labels. Its pull request brings the step Files of the project of scripts/check.sh, which asks whether a release has left something to move. Where nothing is left, or the file declines the move, the pull request merges itself. Otherwise the check runs migrate --fix, and the fix bot commits the move onto the pull request, whose checks run again.
